name: WordCraft v0.10.0
body:
> [!NOTE]
> **FreeBSD aarch64 is dropped from this release.** We had to cut releases, and we cannot build this target within the 5-hour CI limit for any of the Craft apps, so we are dropping it for now. This is a known blocker, flagged for a future fix in storytold/craft-common-actions#39. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included.

## What's Changed
* docs: add SonarCloud and CodeRabbit badges to README by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2935
* Skip CodeRabbit reviews on Dependabot PRs by @echelon in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3302
* CI: run cargo xtask ci on pull requests and pushes to main (#754) by @isaac-levine in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/800
* ci: switch to shared nix workflow from craft-common-actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2381
* #3243: File › Recover follows the app theme by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3435
* Mini toolbar: scroll-under-ribbon test follows #1501's visible anchor (#1841) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1842
* Proofing: Check spelling as you type is remembered across restarts (#1792) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1837
* Double-clicking a later page's footer opens it without scrolling up (#2103) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2214
* The I-beam pointer shows on white paper on Windows (#1746) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2230
* Borders: triple borders draw as three lines on screen and in PDF (#1740) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2210
* Layout: text above a float's anchor wraps around it (#2048) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2237
* Focus fills the screen; Full Screen View is a bindable command (#1678) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1733
* security: enforce HTTPS on curl downloads (SonarCloud S6506) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3532
* ci: pin GitHub Actions to full commit SHA (SonarCloud S7637) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3531
* Shape fills: gradients and transparency (#1500) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1605
* Legacy menu keys: Alt, V, U and 17 more Word 2003 sequences (#1697) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/1769
* Use chrono instead of hand-rolled UTC conversion by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3427
* #1281: English dialects in proofing — en-GB, en-CA, en-AU… flag each other's spellings (#1045) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2632
* #2617: centre equation-array rows without & by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/2690
* File › New: personal templates from a user templates folder (#2852) by @benandez in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3133
* Merge 178 open PRs (backlog round 1) by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3555
* Russian and Czech dictionaries are reported, not just checked (#3226) by @MichaelMuClaude in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3252
* Find box and Results list borrow a document font for Georgian etc. (#3248) by @MichaelMuClaude in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3257
* Docs: control protocol's Methods table renders again by @mikael2 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3258
* Unstyle TOC entry links whose Hyperlink style has a localized id by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft/pull/3260
